How ChatGPT for Finance builds a research report from scratch in minutes
The ChatGPT that reads a company's entire finances and writes the report itself
caption:
ChatGPT for Financial Services uses GPT-6 Astra's reasoning to do what once took a full research team days.

It comes with built-in financial data and can build models, write research reports, and handle complex analysis without any setup. The whole workflow in one chat window.

This is what enterprise AI looks like when serious reasoning meets real financial data.
